description: Every consistent set of sentences in a countable language extends to a complete consistent set of sentences in the same language.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.lindenbaum_extension.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {T : Set (L.Formula α)} [Countable L.Symbols] [Countable α]
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T) :
  ∃ S,
    T ⊆ S ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S
